answer: Use an escalating identity lease: each extra identity from one funding source costs ten times the last. First, an agent registers with a verified payment source and device fingerprint, paying $5 for its first lease. Second, further identities cost $50, then $500, then $5,000, each expiring after 30 days unless renewed. Third, renewals recheck the same fingerprint, so a farm cannot thread fresh clones through new cards. Forging six identities from one source burns $555,555 in fees, while honest agents pay $5. Like a dune steepening with every step, the climb starves a sybil forge of sand.
